messages:
Alex Kim: Quick sync: were rolling analytics from events_json -> a sharded metrics_index (tenant_id, hour, metric, value, tags_hash). Goal: speed up dashboard p95.
Maria Lopez: Need precise schema diff so console query layer can adapt.
Alex Kim: metrics_index flattens aggregates per hour and adds tags_hash for fast group-bys. Legacy path still supports raw scans.
Jordan Patel: Plan: dual-write ingest to both stores, read-adapter that prefers metrics_index and falls back to legacy when rows missing.
Sandeep Rao: Ops note: shard = tenant_hash % 128. Hot tenant risk: propose pre-identify top 50 tenants and map them to dedicated shards to avoid hotspots.
Priya Nair: UX: mixed latency will surface to users. Show ephemeral banner + lightweight skeleton charts when fallback used. AB test two banner variants.
Alex Kim: Rollout sequence: 1) dual-write 48h; 2) reconciliation job (shadow run to estimate); 3) throttled backfill with per-tenant cursors; 4) per-tenant feature-flag reads: canary 2% -> 20% -> 100%; 5) monitor and expand.
Jordan Patel: Reconcile probe SQL:
```
SELECT tenant_id, hour, COUNT(*) missing FROM expected_hours e
LEFT JOIN metrics_index m USING (tenant_id, hour)
WHERE m.tenant_id IS NULL
GROUP BY tenant_id, hour
ORDER BY missing DESC LIMIT 100;
```
Maria Lopez: Telemetry we need: metric_read.path=(index|fallback|legacy), metric_read.latency_ms, reconcile.missing_count, backfill.rate. Retain 7d for canary.
Sandeep Rao: Router circuit-breaker: if shard_cpu_p95 > 70% OR read_latency_p95 > 600ms then auto-fallback tenants on that shard. Alerts: reconcile.missing_count > 500/hr, read_errors > 0.5% 5m, shard_cpu_p95 > 80% 5m.
Priya Nair: Product will own AB variants: banner copy + experiment flag per workspace. Also track chart_fallback_rate and banner_ack.
Alex Kim: Quota impact: tag reads with quota_label=metrics_index so billing/limits remain correct. Update quota dashboards.
Jordan Patel: I'll prototype backfill with resumable cursors and S3 resume tokens; aim for staging PoC Tue.
Sandeep Rao: Ill draft runbook + rollback steps (disable feature-flag, stop backfill, scale down workers).
Maria Lopez: Ill run staging canary and wire telemetry topics.
Priya Nair: Ill draft banner copy and experiment plan.
deploy-bot: Read-adapter v2 deployed to staging (build: 2026.03.20-823). Canary tests starting.
Alex Kim: Thanks. Daily standups during first 72h of prod canary. Final sync Thu 10:00.
